name: Ashenvale Outrunners
summary: In Ashenvale, Kuray'bin sends the Horde against night elf scouts slipping out from Silverwing Outpost. They are gathering word of Horde encampments and defenses before they can report back.

sections.title: Eyes in the Canopies
sections.body:
Night elf scouts from Silverwing Outpost move through the woods east of their base and south of nearby Horde holdings. They watch the paths and ridges, mapping fortifications and tracking troop movements.

Kuray'bin has learned that these scouts, called Ashenvale Outrunners, have slipped into the wilderness to gather intelligence.

sections.title: Blinding the Alliance
sections.body:
The Horde strikes at enemy scouts before they can return to Silverwing Outpost. Hunting down the outrunners keeps their commanders from learning the Horde's troop strength and outpost defenses.

Without their forward eyes, the night elves are disoriented and less willing to risk aggressive moves through the contested woods.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Ashenvale Outrunners?
faq.answer: Kuray'bin, the Horde scout coordinator stationed in Ashenvale, gives the order. He tracks and counters night elf movements across the forest.

faq.q: Where are the Ashenvale Outrunners located?
faq.answer: The outrunners patrol the forests east of Silverwing Outpost and south of Kuray'bin's camp. They gather intelligence through the underbrush.

faq.q: Why are the outrunners a threat to the Horde?
faq.answer: The outrunners are advanced scouts operating from Silverwing Outpost. If they map Horde encampments and troop counts, the Alliance can plan precise raids against vulnerable positions.
Silverwing Outpost is a prominent night elf military installation in Ashenvale. Alliance forces use it as a frontline base to defend the forest and contest Horde expansion.

faq.q: Is this quest part of a longer storyline?
faq.answer: This effort stands alone as a way to reduce Alliance reconnaissance in the area. Fighters who help Kuray'bin secure the perimeter earn a reward.

faq.q: Can Alliance players complete this quest?
faq.answer: No. Kuray'bin works for the Horde alone on Ashenvale's frontlines.

angles.text: As Horde, each night elf scout you cut down helps protect local encampments and lumber operations from coordinated Alliance counterattacks.
As a hunter, you use keen instincts, heightened tracking senses, and sharp marksmanship to find concealed outrunners in deep woodland.
As a rogue, you turn night elf stealth against them. By neutralizing their outrunners, you help Horde infiltrators hold the forest's shadows.
